integrity.computation_scope: Finite integer-exact diagnostic tests only; not offered as proof for all dimensions.
integrity.exact_claim_scope: All integers \(p,q\ge2\) with \(p\ne q\), and every \(N\ge1\); weak spectral asymptotic for fixed parameters as \(N\to\infty\).
integrity.proof_basis: Integer-divisibility path decomposition, exact rank identities, finite path eigenvectors, uniform geometric tail.

scientific_limitations: Unweighted Hardy H2 positive-degree polynomial sections for unequal integer power maps only.
The limiting spectral measure concerns Hermitian parts of finite compressions, not singular values of the infinite operator.
General historical theorems on partial-permutation finite sections might imply some formulas; independent priority review remains outstanding.
title: Arithmetic universality and pure-point spectral laws for monomial cross-composition sections
